cosmosbeta-desc: Cosmos is a skin designed and based off Fandom's Oasis skin. Designed to improve upon their design, and provide an efficient MediaWiki skin for non-Fandom users, or for users transitioning out of Fandom. If you wish, you may join the [https://discord.gg/GPVgFTaQTJ Cosmos Discord server] if you require assistance with theming or something else.
cosmosbeta-createpage-text: We currently have '''$1''' {{PLURAL:$1|article|articles}} on $2. Type your article name above $3
cosmosbeta-createpage-wanted-pages: or click on one of the titles below and start writing!
cosmosbeta-createpage-no-wanted-pages: or create one of the articles listed [[$1|here]]!
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-text: Customize how the '''Cosmos''' skin looks on this wiki. Changes go live when you publish, and every published version is kept so you can go back to it.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-readonly: You can look at the current theme, but you do not have permission to change it.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-nojs: The theme designer needs JavaScript. You can still edit the settings under Advanced.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-advanced-help: The theme as JSON. Anything invalid is ignored when you publish.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-error-permissio: You do not have permission to change the theme.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-error-token: Your session expired. Reload the page and try again.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-error-json: The theme data could not be read.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-presets-intro: Pick a ready made palette. It replaces the colors for its mode, and you can still change each color afterwards.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-preset-applied: Palette applied. Publish to make it live.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-colors-intro: Use the picker or type any CSS color. Leave a field empty to use the default for this wiki.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-color-banner-he: Background of the bar with search and the user menu.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-color-header-he: Background of the wiki name and navigation tabs.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-color-content-h: Background of articles and the rail.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-color-toolbar-h: Background of the page tools at the bottom.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-color-invalid: That is not a color the designer understands.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-images-intro: Use a file name from this wiki or a full web address. Leave empty for none.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-rail-anons: Hide the rail from visitors who are not logged in
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-rail-namespaces: Namespace numbers separated by commas. Leave empty for the wiki default.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-rail-pages-help: One page title per line. Leave empty for the wiki default.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-darkmode-intro: Cosmos has a dark mode of its own. Each mode keeps its own colors, so you can edit them separately under Colors.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-darkmode-toggle: Let people switch between light and dark
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-darkmode-genera: Make dark colors from the light ones
Dark colors made. Check them under Colors, then publish.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-darkmode-builti: The switch appears in the user menu. Logged in users keep their choice in their preferences. Visitors keep it in their browser.
cosmosbeta-themedesigner-history-intro: Every published theme is kept. Restoring one publishes it again as the newest version.
